rows.label: tlk70000016_02_msg0002
rows.name:
My grandpa and grandma have been
praying to the god of Acedia all this
time...

rows.label: tlk70000016_02_msg0003
rows.name:
But Mom and Dad say times like this
are when Iira should show what its
science and technology can do...

rows.label: tlk70000016_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Which of them is right?
I'm really lost...

rows.label: tlk70000016_02_msg0005
rows.name:
What?! You mean that there's
not one right answer? They
could BOTH be right?!

rows.label: tlk70000016_02_msg0006
rows.name:
I guess so... You're right! God and
science were both meant to make
everyone happy in the first place!

rows.label: tlk70000016_02_msg0007
rows.name:
All right! I'll go tell my
whole family about this!
